# CloudScribe

> CloudScribe is a small statically typed scripting language for IT automation that compiles to JavaScript for Node.js. It has int, string, boolean, array, optional and function types, `task` blocks and functions, compile-time type checking with line and column errors, built-ins for environment variables, files and shell commands, and a CLI that can type-check, compile or run a `.csc` file. The compiler is written in plain Node.js ESM with an Ohm grammar and no build step, and also runs in the browser playground on the project site.

- [Agent guide](https://github.com/patrickking67/cloudscribe/blob/main/AGENTS.md): commands, layout, conventions and definition of done for contributors and coding agents
